liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): The rare opener sequence set the tone for a relaxed, fluid performance [13]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Jerry sang his heart out, potentially the best live version ever [16]
- **Corrina** (1 review): The performance converted a critic into a fan and led into the Drums [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-06-11.111293.nak300.Boeditaper.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1993-06-11.mtx.unknown.100405.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 170 min; rated 4.55/5 by 11 [3]
- **gd1993-06-11.157051.dts.tobin.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 164 min [9]
- **gd93-06-11.sbd.gans.19217.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 153 min; rated 4.03/5 by 39 [10]. Said about its sound: Bobby's guitar seemed to reverberate up the hills during the performance; Thin sound, muffled sections, and Garcia's guitar dropping in and out [21][24]

## Around the show

- Reviewer declared love to partner while rocking under stars during this song [14]
- Trees were yelling by the time Sting's set began, before the show [17]
- Entry required passing through a cattle chute near a farmhouse and cows [18]
- Naked man shouted needing a condom and wanting to love Jerry Garcia [8]
- The show matches Cal Expo and surpasses the recent Detroit performances overall [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-06-11.111293.nak300.Boeditaper.flac16**: source: Source:Sony D6 Cassette Master>Nakamichi 300 Mics W/CP4 Shotguns>Sony Tc We-325 Home Cassette Deck(PLayback)>Edirol R-09 HR>CD Wav Editor>Traders Little… [1]
- **gd1993-06-11.mtx.unknown.100405.flac16**: source: 3-Source SBD/AUD Matrix: SBD: shnid=34399, AUD 1: shnid=34163, and AUD 2: shnid=3192 see info files for details [3]. Also: FOB recording by Evans, Gross, Pobega using Schoeps mics and Panasonic DAT [3]
- **gd1993-06-11.157051.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix [9]. Also: DTS 5.1 surround mix created by an archive.org user in 2022 [9]
- **gd93-06-11.sbd.gans.19217.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard->DAT Master->Sonic Solutions->CD->EAC->SHN. CD seed provided by DG. EAC and SHN by Joe Samaritano. [10]. Also: Reviewer taped the show, later confusing years while listening to the recordings [20]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Buckeye Lake Music Center - June 11, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-11-1993) [26]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Buckeye Lake Music Center - June 11, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/june-11-1993) [27]
